title: The Missing Poster Mix-Up
text: A small group meets in a library room. They make a poster for a lost cat. The cat's name is Mimi. The poster has a photo and a phone number. But the number is wrong. It is not Anna's number. Anna says, "Is this your number, Ben?" Ben says, "No, it is not. My number is different." The group is not happy. They look at the poster again. Who has the right number? A woman at the desk says, "Are you the cat group? I have a new number for you." The group says, "Yes, we are!" They write the new number on the poster. Now the poster is correct. The group is very happy.

What else is on the poster with the phone number?
